items.title: Resting Arctic Fox
items.alt: A white arctic fox curls its fluffy tail around its body and looks forward.
items.description: A white arctic fox curls its fluffy tail around its body and looks forward. Use the resting fox on winter wildlife cards or beside observations in a personal nature journal.

items.title: Red Cardinal on Snowy Holly
items.alt: A red northern cardinal perches on a snowy holly branch with green leaves and red berries.
items.description: A red northern cardinal perches on a snowy holly branch with green leaves and red berries. Add the perching bird to a winter birdwatching worksheet or a personal seasonal greeting card.

items.title: Cozy Penguin with Hot Cocoa
items.alt: A smiling penguin in a red winter hat and mustard scarf holds a steaming mug of cocoa.
items.description: A smiling penguin in a red winter hat and mustard scarf holds a steaming mug of cocoa. Place the cozy penguin beside a winter reading prompt or on a personal journal page.

items.title: Child Building a Snowman
items.alt: A child in a coral coat kneels beside a snowman and adds its carrot nose.
items.description: A child in a coral coat kneels beside a snowman and adds its carrot nose. Use this winter activity scene for storytelling, sequencing tasks or a classroom display.
